about.title: About Me
about.description: My journey began when I heard the phrase 'HTML is the future,' sparking my passion for programming and propelling me towards a career as a developer. Since then, I've immersed myself in the world of technology, constantly honing my skills and exploring new tools and technologies. My expertise lies in creating exceptional digital experiences, both for the web and apps, with a particular focus on efficient and elegant implementation of user interfaces.
